name: Eval Dashboard navigation and the agent editor's Evals tab
description: SPEC-04's browser smoke path: sidebar → /eval → an agent's eval page → the agent editor's Evals tab, surviving a reload. It covers no acceptance criterion on its own — AC-59, AC-68 and AC-69 each have a hermetic RTL test that is their primary proof (EvalsTab.test.tsx, useGlobalShortcuts.test.ts, EvalDashboardView.test.tsx). What this flow adds is the one thing jsdom cannot say: that the three NEW App Router routes actually build and serve, and that the sidebar row added to nav.ts resolves to a page rather than a 404. Slot 12, not 11: 11-project-context.flow.json holds that one (plan D-18). FALLBACK TAKEN (a): the `g e` chord is NOT driven here, for the reason 11-project-context.flow.json records at length — `agent-browser`'s `press` holds the key down and one invocation dispatches ~180 auto-repeat keydowns, which for a g-chord means ~90 duplicate router.push calls. The sidebar row is clicked instead, and UX-8's chord keeps its guaranteed proof in useGlobalShortcuts.test.ts. DETERMINISTIC AND READ-ONLY: it opens and clicks. It presses no Run control, enqueues no batch and spends no provider money — the seeded workspace holds no eval case, so the empty state is the correct render and asserting it is asserting the truth rather than working around a gap.
